a100.energy_interpretation: Idle subtraction measures a small difference between much larger totals. Round spread and idle drift limit precision; this is not a statistical confidence interval.
a100.implementation: two FP32 handwritten-PTX kernels emitted by pyptx (gpu_benchmark_ptx.py)
a100.scope: CUDA-graph replays of complete training and 1000 predictions on device-resident normalized float32 inputs; includes host-dispatch gaps between graph replays; excludes transfers, preprocessing, allocation, JIT, module load and capture. Signed NVML total-energy deltas minus mean paired idle power times measured wall duration; negative estimates are retained.

grid.scope: complete globally serialized training and prediction; all input/output, scratch, staging and interprocessor traffic counted; emitted labels checked against frozen predictions on all 11 draws
grid.lowering: v2.1: unnormalized resized inputs; polynomial scoring with shared query products; staged samples; density-ordered placement; skips zeroing only of k, xs, prod, labels, x

learner: closed-form QDA (per-class Gaussian, full covariance, no shrinkage, class prior, log-determinant), ordered FP32

provenance.limitation: Original protocol timestamp is later than original evaluation freeze. Reproduction uses published evaluation draws and does not establish pre-evaluation protocol freezing.

accuracy_fresh.note: Fresh eleven-draw evaluation after PR 82 review; protocol, manifest, freeze, and score occur in successive commits. Local timestamps do not independently establish absence of prior evaluation.
